findings.passage: Election integrity: We need to ensure election integrity so that there is transparency throughout the entire voting process. We need to be able to verify everything from voter roles, voting machines, and mail-in voting, and do ballot harvesting. AND we need to make sure NO company, entity or person has a monopoly on our voting process, and I will be pushing for change.
findings.note: Campaign issues page, Politics section. Date is the page's last-modified date (first published 2022-02-23). Calls for verification of voter rolls, voting machines and mail-in voting, and for ending any monopoly on the voting process. Does not mention photo ID, ID for mail ballots, or proof of citizenship.
